content.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 Walking a Fine Line
content.summary: The $10-50 price range often includes mid-sized businesses with proven track records and plenty of growth runway ahead. They also usually carry less risk than penny stocks, though they’re not immune to volatility as many lack the scale advantages of their larger peers.

content.title: 1 Restaurant Stock on Our Buy List and 2 We Turn Down
content.summary: Restaurants increase convenience and give many people a place to unwind. But it’s not all sunshine and rainbows as they’re notoriously hard to run thanks to perishable ingredients, labor shortages, or volatile consumer spending. Unfortunately, these factors have spelled trouble for the industry as it has shed 15.8% over the past six months. This performance is a noticeable divergence from the S&P 500’s 13.1% return.
